howto: Press Play: the bird hovers until your first tap.
Tap, click or press Space to flap. Short taps keep the bird level.
Fly through the gaps between the pipes: each pipe is 1 point. Golden feathers are coins.
Spend feathers on new birds in Skins, and finish the day's goals for more.
tips: Short, steady taps beat big panicky ones.
Three close shaves in a row, or a blue bubble, give you a shield that saves you from one crash.
The pipes speed up and the gaps narrow slowly, and the sky changes from golden hour to dusk to night every 12 pipes.
Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum medals are at 10, 20, 35 and 60 pipes; Gold and Platinum unlock the Golden and Phoenix birds.
Sprint mode ends after 20 pipes; Gale mode makes every pipe sway.

controls.keyboard: Space or Up arrow to flap. P or Esc pauses.

difficulty: An adaptive curve: the first pipes have wide gaps and a slow scroll, then the gaps narrow and the pipes speed up over about 25 pipes. Gale mode makes every pipe sway up and down; Sprint mode is a 20-pipe dash.

cheats.effect: Ghost bird: fly through pipes and bounce off the ground
Wide gaps: every pipe gap is 22% taller
Slow motion: the whole sky runs at 60% speed

features.one-tap-start: Play, then one tap flaps and starts the run
features.instant-restart: Play Again, a tap on the results card or Space goes straight back to the hovering bird
features.best-score-badge: Best on the title and on the results card, with a medal target under the score while you play
features.tutorial-card: Get-ready card with a tapping finger on the first run
features.results: Result card with score, medal, best, top-5 scores, feathers earned, today's goals and the next bird to unlock
features.progression: Nine birds (seven bought with feathers, two unlocked by medals), three daily goals plus a star challenge, a week of play stamps with a weekly gift, Bronze to Platinum medals, ranks
features.daily-goals: Three goals and one star challenge a day, the same for everyone that day
